'''''Z-Omega 1''''' was a [[Gamma-class ATR-6 assault transport]] that fought on the side of [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Demetrius Zaarin]]'s [[Zaarin coup forces|coup]] during the [[Second battle of Imperial Center]]<ref name="TIE fighter guide" /> in around [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]].<ref name="Date" /> During the battle, the transport was destroyed after being hit by two pairs of [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Missile/Legends|missiles]] and multiple [[Warhead/Legends|warheads]].<ref name="TIE fighter guide" />
